home.title: Ka ganacso boorsadaada
home.subtitle: Ku xidh boorsadaada, kaganacso spot iyo perpetuals adigoo maraya exchange-yo aan hoggaan lahayn, adigoo hayaya hantidaada waqti kasta. FLT weligeed ma hayso furayaashaada mana taabato lacagtaada.

landing.title: Kaganacso exchange-yada aan hoggaan lahayn adigoo aan waxba u dhiibin hantidaada.
landing.subtitle: FLT wuxuu jihaynayaa dalabkaaga isagoo maraya lacag-bax on-chain ah, wuxuuna dhisayaa dhaqdhaqaaqa. Boorsadaadu way saxiixdaa, blockchain-ku wuu xasilliyaa, lacagtaaduna weligeed ma marto annaga. Weligayo kuma weydiisanno seed phrase ama furaha gaarka ah, maxaa yeelay marnaba uma baahnin.

steps.title: Ku xidh boorsadaada
steps.body: Ku xidh boorsad iskood u maamusha adigoo saxiixaya fariin. Ma jiro wareejin, ma jiro dhigasho, mana jirto gas.

steps.title: Dib u eeg jidka
steps.body: Arag wixii la filayo in laga helo, ugu yaraan la dammaanad qaaday, saameynta qiimaha, khidmad kasta, iyo qandaraaska loo yeeraya.

steps.title: Adigu iska saxiix
steps.body: Boorsadaadu way saxiixdaa oo way baahisaa. FLT ma haysto furayaal mana wado inuu dhaqaajiyo lacagtaada.

steps.title: Ku xasilo chain-ka
steps.body: Waan dan qabsanaa dhaqdhaqaaqa oo waxaan diiwaan galinnaa waxa dhab ahaan dhacay, ee ma aha waxa la filayey.

landing.whatWeDontDoIntro: In la caddeeyo xaddidaadaha ayaa ka muhiimsan liiska sifooyinka. FLT si ula kac ah uma aha exchange dhexe, waxyaabo badan oo aad ka filan lahayd mid noocaas ah ayaa ugu maqan qaab-dhismeedka.
landing.perpsAddendum: Leverage-ka (perpetual futures) waxay u furan yihiin akoomada la xaqiijiyay, waana alaab leverage leh: si iskood ah ayaa loo xiri karaa, waxaadna lumin kartaa margin-ka ka danbeeya.
dontDoItems: Ma haysanno hantidaada, sidaa darteed ma jiro rasiid FLT ah oo aad ka bixin karto.
Ma wado buug amar (order book) mana isku dari karno ganacsigaaga gudaha.
Ma soo celin karno dhaqdhaqaaq. Marka boorsadaadu saxiixdo, wuxuu ku jiraa chain-ka.
Hantidaada ma haysanno, sidaa darteed wax aan ku amaahin karno ama lumin karno halkan kuma jiraan.
Weligayo kuma weydiin doono seed phrase, furaha gaarka ah, ama furaha boorsadaada — qofna sax ahi ma weydiin doono.
landing.disclaimer: Hantida dijitaalka ah way isbedbeddeshaa waxaadna lumin kartaa lacag. Ganacsigu wuxuu ku xasilaa blockchain-yo dadweyne, mana soo noqon karto marka la saxiixo. FLT-Exchange waxay bixisaa interface lagaga gaadho lacag-bax aan hoggaan lahayn; ma bixiso talo maalgashi mana hayso hantida macaamiisha.

plans.title: Qorshayaasha

perpMarketPage.footerNote: Qiimayaasha, qoto dhererka buugga, iyo ganacsiyada waxaa soo warramaya {venue}, ma aha FLT, mana aha qiime la bixiyay. Perpetual-ku ma laha wakhti dhammaad ah: wuu socon karaa ilaa aad xirto ama ilaa suuqu kaa gees u dhaqaaqo si ku filan in suuqu xiro booska margin-kiisuna dhammaado. Wicitaan margin ah ma jiro. Wax kama qasban, lacagna kama dhaqaajin, mana u oggolaanayso FLT inuu wax ka qabto booskaaga — waxay diiwaan gelisaa waxa ilaalintu u baahnaan lahayd, wayna la socotaa markay qiimaha isbedbedelaan.

referrals.title: Jeedinta
referrals.subtitle: La wadaag koodkaaga. Waxaad heli 20% dakhliga FLT ee ka imaanaya qof kasta oo ganacsanaya isagoo isticmaalaya.
referrals.codeExplainer: Qofkasta oo isticmaala wuxuu helayaa {days} maalmood oo {tier} ah oo bilaash ah. Waxaad heli {pct}% waxa FLT ka kasbanayo iyaga — khidmadaha ganacsiga iyo qorshayaasha — inta ay ganacsanayaan.
referrals.connectFirst: Marka hore ku xidh oo xaqiiji boorsad — halkaas ayaa lacagta laguu bixinayaa.
referrals.nothingEarnedYet: Wali waxba lama kasbanin. Qayb ayaa la diiwaan geliyaa mar kasta oo qofkaad jeedisay uu bixiyo khidmad ganacsi ama uu iibsado qorshe.
referrals.earningsFooter: Faa'iidooyinku waxaa loo diiwaan geliyaa ganacsi kasta iyo lacag-bixin kasta, sidaa darteed tiro kasta waa la kala saari karaa. Waa lacago la leeyahay halkii ay noqon lahaayeen hadhaag la haysto — FLT ma haysto float — qaybta khidmadda ganacsigana waxaa lagu qeexaa token-kii khidmadda laga qaaday, taasoo ah sababta ay isugu darsanayn.

referrals.freeMonthActive: Bisha bilaashka ah waa firfircoon ilaa {date}.
referrals.oneLevelFooter: Hal heer kaliya. Waxaad ka kasbataa dadka aad jeedisay oo qura — heer labaad ma jiro, jeedinta qof jeediya qof kale kuma siin doonto wax qofka saddexaad ka yimaada.

passiveCash.title: Xisaabta Lacagta Fadhiya
passiveCash.description: Lacagta fadhiya waxaa loo isticmaalaa suuq-samaynta FLT. Waxaad haysataa {profitPct}% faa'iido kasta waxaadna qaadataa {lossPct}% khasaare kasta. Waqti kasta ayaa laga bixin karaa.
passiveCash.notOperationalBody: Buugga suuq-samaynta wax fulin ah kuma jiro deployment-kan, sidaa darteed lacagta halkan la geliyay looma isticmaali karo. In lala qaato haddana waxay noqon lahayd in khidmad aan shaqaynayn la iibiyo.
passiveCash.dialogTitle: Ka hor inta aadan furin tan
passiveCash.dialogIntro: Tani way ka duwan tahay wax kasta oo kale oo FLT ku jira. Hadhaagaaga ganacsigu weligiis kama bixi boorsadaada. Tanina way ka bixidaa. Akhri qodob kasta oo calaamadee.
passiveCash.termsVersion: Nooca shuruudaha {version}. Haddii kuwani isbeddelaan waxaa lagaa codsan doonaa inaad mar kale akhrido.

walletsPage.title: Boorsooyinka
walletsPage.description: Boorsooyinka iskood u maamusha ee akoonkaaga ku xidhan. Furayaashaadu waligood ka bixi maayaan qalabkaaga, FLT-na ma dhaqaajin karto lacagtaada.
walletsPage.totalBalanceHint: Wax kasta oo akoonkaaga FLT ku jira, oo lagu qiimeeyay dollarka. Awoodda iibsigu waa stablecoin-ka aad hadda isticmaali karto.
walletsPage.unsupportedChainsNote: +{count} shabakad oo aan weli la akhrin karin
walletsPage.noWalletBody: Ku xidh boorsad iskood u maamusha adigoo saxiixaya fariin. Gas kuma baahna, mana ogolaanayso wax bixin ah.
walletsPage.previouslyLinkedBody: Cinwaannadan mar dambe kuma xidhna. Taariikhda macaamiishoodu way sii jirtaa — furitaanka boorsad kama tirtirto ganacsigii lagu saxiixay.
walletsPage.howLinkingWorksBody: Ku xidhitaanka boorsad wuxuu u oggolaanayaa browser-kaaga inuu la hadlo. Xidhitaanku hal tallaabo ayuu ka sii socdaa: waxaad saxiixdaa fariin gaaban oo caddaynaysa inaad hantid cinwaanka, taasoo u oggolaanaysa FLT inay muujiso haraagaaga oo aad ugu xilsaarto macaamiishaada. Saxiixu maaha dhaqdhaqaaq, gas kuma baahna, mana siiyo oggolaansho bixin.

accountPage.activeSessionsDesc: Halka akoonkaagu hadda ku jiro. Haddii aadan garanayn mid, beddel furahaaga — taasi way baabbi'isaa fadhi kasta.
accountPage.knownDevicesDesc: Qalabyada akoonkan geliyay, hadday fadhi firfircoon leeyihiin ama ay ka maqan yihiin.
accountPage.firstSeenLastSeen: markii ugu horreysay {first} · markii ugu dambaysay {last}
accountPage.neverAsksDesc: Qofna sax ah kuma weydiin doono kuwan — FLT ma aha, taageero ma aha, qof kalena ma aha.
accountPage.seedPhrase: Seed phrase-kaaga ama erayada soo celinta
accountPage.saveRecoveryCodesDesc: Koodh kastaa hal mar ayuu shaqeeyaa, haddii aad lumiso gelitaanka barnaamijkaaga xaqiijinta. Waxaa kaliya la keydiyaa hash-kooda, sidaa darteed tan waa markii kaliya ee la muujin karo.
accountPage.twoFactorDesc: Tallaabo labaad ayaa ilaalisa akoonkaaga xitaa haddii furahaaga la xado.
accountPage.runningLowHint: Way yaraanayaan. Xir oo mar kale fur MFA si aad u samayso set cusub.
accountPage.askedEachSignIn: Waxaa lagaa weydiin doonaa koodh ka yimaada barnaamijkaaga xaqiijinta mar kasta oo aad gasho.
accountPage.addSecretBody: Ku dar sirtan barnaamijkaaga xaqiijinta, kadibna geli koodhka lix-tirsan ee uu muujiyo.

tradeClient.broadcastBody: Boorsadaadu way saxiixday oo dirtay dhaqdhaqaaqa. Xasilintu waxay ku dhacdaa chain-ka waxayna qaadataa dhowr ilbiriqsi. FLT ayaa dan qabsanaya oo diiwaan gelin doona natiijada.
tradeClient.approvalSubmitted: Ogolaanshaha waa la gudbiyay. Marka uu ku xaqiiqmo chain-ka, codso qiime cusub si aad u dhammaystirto ganacsiga.
tradeClient.differentWalletBody: Boorsadaada browser-ka waa {connected}, laakiin ganacsigan waxaa loo diyaariyay {preferred}. Ku beddel akoonnada boorsadaada, ama ku xidh tan hadda ku xidhan.
tradeClient.connectToSign: Ku xidh boorsadaada si aad u saxiixdo. Cinwaankaaga ku xidhan waa {address}.
tradeClient.fltSignsNote: FLT ayaa ka saxiixaysa boorsadaada FLT ({address}). Waxba ma xidhi kartid.
tradeClient.fltSignsFooter: FLT waxay dhaqdhaqaaqan ka dirtaa boorsada FLT ee Privy kuugu haysa, iyadoo la raacayo oggolaanshaha aad bixisay. Wakhti kasta waad ka noqon kartaa oggolaanshahaas.
tradeClient.walletSignsNote: Boorsadaadu way saxiixdaa dhaqdhaqaaqan. FLT weligeed ma haysto lacagtaada mana dhaqaajin karto.
tradeClient.indicativeHint: Tani waa qiime tilmaan ah. Codso qiime si aad u aragto natiijada saxda ah, ugu yaraan la dammaanad qaaday, khidmad kasta, iyo qandaraaska boorsadaadu la weydiin doonto inay wacdo.
tradeClient.enterAmountHint: Geli qadar si aad u aragto waxa ganacsigani kaa qaadan doono iyo halka uu ku fulin doono.
tradeClient.minimumReceivedTooltip: Waxaa ku qasban chain-ka. Haddii pool-ku uusan bixin karin ugu yaraan tan, dhaqdhaqaaqu wuu dib u noqdaa waxaadna hayaan wixii aad gelisay.
tradeClient.priceImpactTooltip: Waxaa lagu qiyaasay in la barbardhigo qiimahan iyo mid ganacsi tixraac ah oo aad yar. Bixiyaha jidka ma soo warrayo tan si toos ah.
tradeClient.networkFeeHint: Adigu waxaad u bixisay shabakada, ma aha FLT
tradeClient.settlesOnBase: Dhaqdhaqaaqani wuxuu ku xasilaa Base. Marka boorsadaadu saxiixdo, ma la joojin karo mana soo celin karo FLT ama qof kale.
tradeClient.declinedNoFunds: Waad diiday codsiga boorsadaada. Waxba lama saxiixin, lacagna kama dhaqaaqin.
tradeClient.insufficientFunds: Boorsadani kuma filna ganacsiga iyo khidmadda shabakada.
tradeClient.pendingRequest: Boorsadaadu horeba waxay leedahay codsi sugaya. Fur oo halkaas ka jawaab marka hore.
tradeClient.genericWalletError: Boorsadaadu ma dhammaystirin karin codsiga. Waxba lama saxiixin.

tradePage.verificationRequiredBody: Aqoonsigaaga waa in la xaqiijiyaa ka hor inta aadan ganacsan. Weli waxaad halkan ku raaci kartaa qiimayaasha intaas lagu jiro.
tradePage.tradingDisabledTitle: Ganacsigu wuu ku demis yahay akoonkan
tradePage.tradingDisabledBody: Maamule ayaa demiyay ganacsiga. La xiriir taageerada haddii aad qabto in tani khalad tahay.
tradePage.connectWalletTitle: Ku xidh boorsad si aad u ganacsato
tradePage.connectWalletBody: FLT ma haysto hantida. Ku xidh boorsad iskood u maamusha, wayna kuu sii jirtaa gacantaada.

marketDetail.unreviewedBody: Qofkasta ayaa deploy garayn kara token oo u magacaabi kara wax kasta. Hubi cinwaanka qandaraaska hoose adigoo isticmaalaya isha aad ku kalsoon tahay ka hor inta aadan ganacsan.
marketDetail.disabledTitle: Ganacsigu wuu ku demis yahay token-kan
marketDetail.addressHint: Had iyo jeer hubi tan ka hor inta aadan ganacsan
marketDetail.recognizedHint: Si weyn loo isticmaalo, laakiin FLT ma eegin

activityDetail.mismatchBody: Xogta chain-ka lagu daray way ka duwan tahay tii FLT qiimeeyay. Tan waa la diiwaan geliyay. Haddii aadan isticmaalin client la beddelay, la xiriir taageerada.
activityDetail.revertedBody: Hantina wax kama dhaqaaqin. Khidmadda shabakadu weli waa la bixiyay, maxaa yeelay shabakaddu way isku daydey. Tani badanaa waxay macnaheedu yahay in qiimuhu ka gudbay ugu yaraan la aqbalay.
activityDetail.networkFeeHint: Adigu waxaad u bixisay shabakada, ma aha FLT
activityDetail.quotedAgainstSettled: Qiimihii la qiyaasay ee la xasilay
activityDetail.expectedToReceive: Wixii la filayay in la helo
activityDetail.minimumHint: Waxaa ku qasban qandaraaska router-ka chain-ka

walletConnect.descLinked: Cinwaankan hadda wuxuu ku xidhan yahay akoonkaaga FLT.
walletConnect.descConnect: FLT weligeed ma haysto hantidaada mana weydiiso seed phrase ama furaha gaarka ah.
walletConnect.noWalletDetected: Boorsad lagama helin browser-kan. Rakibo MetaMask ama extension boorsad kale oo iskood u maamusha si aad u sii wadato.
walletConnect.wrongChainBody: Boorsadaadu waxay ku taal shabakad kale. FLT wuxuu ku ganacsadaa {chain} sidan daabacaadan.
walletConnect.noGas: Gas kuma baahna, mana aha dhaqdhaqaaq.
walletConnect.noSpending: FLT uma oggolaanayo inuu dhaqaajiyo, bixiyo, ama gelo lacagtaada.
walletConnect.signToLink: Saxiix si aad u xidho boorsadan
walletConnect.userRejected: Waad diiday codsiga boorsadaada. Waxba lama saxiixin.
walletConnect.pendingRequest: Boorsadaadu horeba waxay leedahay codsi sugaya. Fur oo halkaas ka jawaab marka hore.
walletConnect.switchAndRetry: Boorsadaada u beddel {chain} oo mar kale isku day.
walletConnect.connectorUnavailable: Boorsadaas browser-kan kama heli karo hadda.
walletConnect.genericWalletError: Boorsadaadu ma dhammaystirin karin codsiga. Isku day mar kale.

meta.rootDescription: Ganacsi aan qofna hayn lacagtaada. Ku xidh boorsadaada oo kaga ganacso suuqyada cryapto-ga adigoo isticmaalaya exchange-yo aan hoggaan lahayn — hantidaada had iyo jeer adigaa haya.

dashboard.confirmEmailBody: Link xaqiijin ah ayaa la soo diray markii aad isdiiwaangelisay. Xaqiijintu looma baahna inaad isticmaasho FLT, laakiin waa sida aad ugu soo laaban karto akoonkaaga haddii aad illowdo furahaaga sirta ah — haddii linkigu aanu kuu iman ama uusan shaqaynayn, dir mid cusub.
dashboard.reviewBody: Xubin ka tirsan kooxdayada sinnaanta ayaa dib u eegaya gudbintaada. Waxaad ku xidhi kartaa boorsad oo baadhi kartaa suuqyada intaa lagu jiro.
dashboard.rejectedFallback: La xiriir taageerada si aad u ogaato talaabada xigta.
dashboard.verifyTitle: Xaqiiji aqoonsigaaga si aad ganacsi u bilowdo
dashboard.verifyBody: Xaqiijintu waa lagama maarmaan ka hor inta aadan dalab ganacsi gelin.
dashboard.tradingDisabledTitle: Ganacsigu wuu ku demis yahay akoonkan
dashboard.tradingDisabledBody: Maamule ayaa demiyay ganacsiga. La xiriir taageerada haddii aad qabto in tani khalad tahay.
dashboard.connectWalletTitle: Ku xidh boorsad si aad ganacsi u bilowdo
dashboard.connectWalletBody: FLT ma haysto hantida. Ku xidh boorsad iskood u maamusha, wayna kuu sii jirtaa gacantaada.
dashboard.noWalletConnectedBody: Ku xidh boorsad iskood u maamusha si aad u aragto haraaga oo aad u ganacsato. Furayaashaadu waligood ka bixi maayaan qalabkaaga.
dashboard.resendConfirmed: Cinwaankan horeba waa la xaqiijiyay. Dib u soo qaad bogga si aad u aragto isbeddelka.
dashboard.resendSent: Waxaa loo diray {email}. Linkigu hal mar ayuu shaqeeyaa wuxuuna dhacaa 24 saacadood — hubi sanduuqaaga spam-ka haddii uusan kuu iman.
dashboard.resendError: Iimaylka lama dirin karin. Isku day daqiiqad kale.
dashboard.noTransactionsBody: Ganacsiyada aad saxiixdo halkan ayay ka soo bixi doonaan, iyagoo wata xaaladdooda chain-ka iyo faahfaahinta xasilinta.

activity.title: Dhaqdhaqaaqa
activity.description: Dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo lagu saxiixay boorsad ku xidhan akoonkan, iyo waxa chain-ku ku sameeyay.
activity.flaggedBody: Xogta chain-ka lagu daray way ka duwan tahay tii FLT qiimeeyay {which}. Tan waa la diiwaan geliyay. Haddii aadan isticmaalin client la beddelay, la xiriir taageerada.
activity.noActivityBody: Ganacsiyada iyo ogolaanshaha token-ka aad saxiixdo halkan ayay ka soo bixi doonaan iyagoo wata xaaladdooda chain-ka.

scanner.title: Baadhe
scanner.description: {count} token oo ku yaal Base, iyo suuq kasta oo perpetual ah. Cinwaannada qandaraasyada had iyo jeer waa la muujiyaa — hubi ka hor inta aadan ganacsan.
scanner.showingMatchesOne: Waxaa la muujinayaa {count} natiijo oo u dhigma "{query}".
scanner.showingMatchesMany: Waxaa la muujinayaa {count} natiijo oo u dhigma "{query}".
scanner.showingFirst: Waxaa la muujinayaa {shown} ee ugu horreeya ee {total}. Isticmaal baadhista si aad u hesho wax kale.
scanner.unreviewedOne: {count} token ayaan weli FLT eegin. Token halkan ka soo muuqda macnaheedu maaha taageero.
scanner.unreviewedMany: {count} token ayaan weli FLT eegin. Token halkan ka soo muuqda macnaheedu maaha taageero.
scanner.noTokensBody: Maamule weli ma furin token loo ganacsan karo.
scanner.footerNote: Qiimaha, xajmiga, iyo liquidity-ga waa qiyaas laga helay bixiye xog suuq oo dhinac saddexaad ah, ee ma aha FLT, mana aha qiimaha ganacsigaagu ku fulin doono. Qiimaynta fulinta waxay ka timaadaa lacag-baxa on-chain ee jira waqtiga aad codsanayso qiime.
scanner.lastUpdated: Markii ugu dambaysay waxaa la cusboonaysiiyay {when}.

passiveCash.title: Lacagta Fadhiya
passiveCash.description: U oggolow lacagta fadhiya inay ka shaqeyso suuq-samaynta FLT, faa'iidada badhkeed. Adigaa qaadan doona khasaaraha.

portfolio.title: Hantida
portfolio.description: Hadhaaga akoonkaaga FLT, oo FLT kuu hayo. Silsiladda waxaa loo isticmaalaa oo keliya qiimeynta.
portfolio.noWalletBody: Ku xidh boorsad iskood u maamusha si aad u aragto haraaga. FLT wuxuu ka akhriyaa chain-ka mana haysto hantidaada.
portfolio.someBalancesTitle: Qaar ka mid ah haraaga lama akhriyi karin
portfolio.networkUnreachableOne: Shabakadu lama gaadhi karin {count} boorsad. Haraagaas way ka maqan yihiin aragtidan halkii la muujin lahaa eber.
portfolio.networkUnreachableMany: Shabakadu lama gaadhi karin {count} boorsadood. Haraagaas way ka maqan yihiin aragtidan halkii la muujin lahaa eber.
portfolio.incompleteHint: Dhammaystiran maaha — qaar haraag ah lama akhriyi karin
portfolio.noBalancesBody: Weli ma lihid hadhaag. Lacagtu waxay halkan ka soo muuqataa markii lacag-dhigasho la xaqiijiyo.
portfolio.footerNote: Hadhaagu waa diiwaanka FLT ee waxa uu kuu hayo. Qiimayaasha lagu qiyaasay waxay isticmaalaan qiimaha dhinaca saddexaad, wayna ka duwanaan doonaan waxa ganacsi dhab ahaan keeni doono. Sadar (—) macnaheedu waa qiimaha aan la garanayn, marnaba ma aha eber.

referrals.title: Jeedinta
referrals.description: La wadaag kood. Waxay helayaan bil bilaash ah, adiguna waxaad heli {pct}% waxa FLT ka kasbanaysa iyaga.

upgrade.title: Kordhi
upgrade.description: Waxa qorshuhu u qiimo lahaan lahaa, xisaab ahaan halkii uu liis sifooyin ahaan lahaa.
upgrade.seeSideBySide: Eeg qorshe kasta oo isbarbar socda

checkout.title: Lacag bixinta
checkout.noPlanBody: Marka hore dooro qorshe, waxaanan halkan kuu soo celinaynaa si aad u bixiso.
checkout.unavailableTitle: Lacag bixinta EVC waa damisan tahay
checkout.unavailableBody: Lacag bixinta EVC Plus weli lama shidin. Waxba lagaama qaadi doono halkan.
checkout.intro: Waxaad taleefankaaga ku wici doontaa kood USSD ah si aad ugu bixiso ganacsadaha {merchant}. Geli magaca iyo lambarka koontada EVC ee aad wax ka bixinayso, si aan lacagtaada u helno.
checkout.payerNameHint: Sida saxda ah ee uu koontadaada EVC ku qoran yahay.
checkout.receiptTo: Waxaan kugula soo xiriiri doonnaa {email} haddii wax aan caddayn jiraan.
checkout.genericError: Wax baa qaldamay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
checkout.dialTitle: Kan wac si aad u bixiso
checkout.pendingBody: Qorshahaagu wuxuu bilaabmayaa marka aan lacagtan ka helno warbixinta EVC. Waxaad bogganan ku soo noqon kartaa.

remittance.title: Dir lacag
remittance.description: Dir lacag dhijitaal ah, lacagta gudahana loo geeyo lambar EVC Plus.
remittance.closedBody: Xawilaadda lama shidin. Waxba lama diri doono.
remittance.verifyBody: Lacag u dirista qof kale waxay u baahan tahay aqoonsi la xaqiijiyay. Kanu waa meesha kaliya ee FLT muddo gaaban lacagtaada hayso, waxaana naga waajib ah inaan ku ogaanno kaaga hor.
remittance.walletBody: Waxaad u baahan tahay boorso la xaqiijiyay oo aad lacagta ka dirto.
remittance.recipientNameHint: Sida saxda ah ee koontadooda EVC ku qoran.
remittance.relationshipHint: Waxaa naga waajib ah inaan weydiinno cidda la siinayo iyo sababta.
remittance.purposeHint: Jawaab gaaban way ku filan tahay.
remittance.connectWallet: Ku xir boorsadaada si aad u saxiixdo.
remittance.genericError: Wax baa qaldamay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
remittance.manualBody: Lacagtaada dhijitaalka ah isla markiiba waa la xaqiijiyaa, laakiin lacagta gudaha waxaa bixiya qof. Ma gaadho isla markaad dirto. Hoos ka daawo.
remittance.receivedBody: {amount} ayaa loo dirayaa {name}. Lacagtaadu waa la xaqiijiyay; gaarsiintase gacan baa lagu sameeyaa, sidaas darteed ma aha isla markiiba. Boggani wuxuu ku tusayaa xaaladda.

fltWallet.title: Boorsada FLT
fltWallet.pitch: Boorso FLT kuu abuurto, si aad u ganacsato adigoon waxba rakibin. Furaha waxaa haya Privy, ma aha FLT — waligeen ma dhaqaajin karno lacagtaada ogolaanshaha hoose la'aantiis, oo waqti kasta ayaad u wareejin kartaa cinwaan kasta.
fltWallet.createError: Boorsada lama abuuri karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
fltWallet.fundingNote: Boorsadan waa madhan tahay ilaa aad lacag u dirto. Lacagta boorsooyinkaaga kale meesheeda ayay ku sii jirtaa — tan abuuriddu waxba ma dhaqaajiso.
fltWallet.permissionBody: Si FLT ganacsi kuugu sameeyo iyada oo aan mar kasta wax lagu weydiin, waxay u baahan tahay ogolaanshahaaga inay boorsadan hago. Kaliya waxay dirtaa ganacsigii aad codsatay, waqti kastana waad ka noqon kartaa.
fltWallet.grantCta: U ogolow FLT inay boorsadan ka ganacsato
fltWallet.grantedBody: FLT waxay geli kartaa ganacsiyada aad codsato boorsadan. Lacag-bixintu had iyo jeer waxay tagtaa cinwaan aad adigu dooratay.
fltWallet.grantError: Ogolaanshaha lama beddeli karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
fltWallet.termsChangedBody: Ogolaanshihii aad bixisay wuxuu ahaa qoraal hore. Fadlan akhri oo aqbal shuruudaha hadda si aad u sii wadato ganacsiga boorsadan.

withdrawPage.title: Lacag qaadasho
withdrawPage.description: Lacagta ka qaado akoonkaaga FLT. Codsigu wuxuu dhawraa qadarka; wareejinta waxaa laga diraa omnibus-ka, hadhaagaaguna wuxuu isbeddelaa marka la xaqiijiyo silsiladda.
withdrawPage.destinationHint: Boorsada aad lacagta u dirayso. Si fiican u hubi — lacag qaadasho lama celin karo.
withdrawPage.overBalance: Taasi waa ka badan hadhaagaaga diyaar ah.
withdrawPage.timingNote: Hadhaagaagu wuxuu isbeddelaa marka wareejintu ku xaqiiqdo silsiladda. Waxaad kala socon kartaa Dhaqdhaqaaqa.
withdrawPage.submitted: Lacag qaadasho waa la codsaday. Dhowaan ayaa la diri doonaa, hadhaagaaguna wuu cusboonaan doonaa marka la xaqiiqdo.
withdrawPage.noAssets: Weli waxba ma lihid oo aad qaadan karto.

deposit.cryptoIntro: Dir USDC ama USDT oo Base ah ciwaankaaga FLT ee hoose. Hadhaagaaga waxaa lagu daraa markii aan on-chain ku xaqiijino.
deposit.cryptoNoticeTitle: Keliya dir USDC ama USDT oo Base ah
deposit.cryptoNotice: Lacag kale ama shabakad kale waa lumi kartaa. Weydii taageerada haddii aadan hubsan.
deposit.fiatIntro: Bangi looma baahna. Ka bixi telefoon kasta oo EVC Plus leh, kadib noo sheeg waxaad dirtay.
deposit.evcStep1: Bixi EVC merchant {merchant}. Telefoonkaagu wuxuu muujinayaa magaca FTL-IT.
deposit.evcStep2: Kadib geli lambarka telefoonka aad ka bixisay iyo lacagta hoose.
deposit.evcPrompt: Telefoonkaagu wuxuu muujinayaa FTL-IT. Haddii uusan muujin, joogso oo la xiriir taageerada.
deposit.withdrawStep1: Fur Lacag qaadasho oo dooro hantida iyo lacagta.
deposit.withdrawStep2: Geli ciwaanka aad u dirtay oo xaqiiji. Hadhaagaagu wuu isbeddelaa markii wareejinta la xaqiijiyo.
deposit.title: Lacag geli
deposit.description: Lacag ku dar crypto ama EVC mobile money.
deposit.needsWalletBody: Lacagtaadu waxay ku soo gashaa boorsadaada FLT, markaa u baahan tahay mid ka hor inta aadan waxba dirin.
deposit.unavailableBody: Hadda ma qaadanayno wareejin. Waxba lagaama qaadi doono halkan.
deposit.intro: Lacagtaada waxaa loo beddelaa doollar, waxaana loogu shubaa hadhaagaaga FLT. Adigay iska leedahay.
deposit.belowMinimum: Lacagta ugu yar ee la geliyo waa {min}.
deposit.genericError: Wax baa qaldamay. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
deposit.pendingBody: Tixraaca ku qor wareejintaada si aan kuugu heli karno. Marka aan lacagta aragno oo aan u beddelno hadhaagaaga, halkan ayuu ka muuqan doonaa.
deposit.payerNameHint: Sida saxda ah ee ku qoran meesha lacagtu ka imanayso.
deposit.payerPhoneHint: Waxaan kaga raadinaa warbixinta si aan lacagtaada u helno.
deposit.dialThis: Kan wac si aad u bixiso
deposit.supportNote: Badanaa waxay qaadataa 1–3 maalmood. Fadlan samir yeelo, oo iimayl u dir support@ftlexchange.com haddii aad su'aal qabto ama wax qaldan u muuqdaan.
